claims.quote: Disease-causing variants in STXBP1 are among the most common genetic causes of neurodevelopmental disorders.

The overall phenotypic landscape in STXBP1-related disorders is characterized by neurodevelopmental abnormalities in 95% and seizures in 89% of individuals, including focal-onset seizures as the most common seizure type (47%).
